text:
alexa: FYI — kicking off a quick collaboration to build a 'quickstart stack' Terraform module for marketplace publishers. Goal: a single opinionated module that can provision a minimal VPC, selectable managed k8s (EKS/GKE/AKS), an ingress LB with TLS hooks, and an example workload + marketplace metadata. Tagging platform and partner engineers for input.

mohit: sounds good. scope question — do we want to support private deployments (VPC peering / shared VPC / NAT) out of the gate or keep first pass public-only to reduce complexity? :thinking:

jess: I'd do two modes: basic-public by default, and an opt-in private_vpc boolean that wires peering/NAT. Keep the interface simple and document advanced networking in the examples folder. Also pin provider versions and add upgrade notes.

ben-platform: +1. Also let's ensure TF 1.5 compatibility and idempotence. I'll own CI: terratest or kitchen-terraform smoke tests against each cloud. Need to add a minimal security baseline (security groups, IAM least-privilege).

cloud-partner-bot: New doc created: https://redwood-internal/docs/marketplace/quickstart-stack-guide — please review :white_check_mark:

mohit: rough tfvars sketch for prototype:
```hcl
module "redwood_quickstart" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@github.com/redwood/marketplace-quickstart.git//modules/stack"
  cloud = "gcp"            # gcp | aws | azure
  enable_private = true     # opt-in VPC peering config
  k8s_version = "1.27"
  instance_profile = "redwood-quickstart-node"
}
```

alexa: timeline check — aim to have partner preview by end of next sprint (~2 weeks). Who's taking docs + QA?

jess: I'll do README + examples for each cloud and a compatibility matrix (k8s versions, region notes). Will include a tiny cost-optimised example (small machine types).

ben-platform: CI scaffold + smoke tests by next Wed. I'll also wire in a basic static analysis step for tfsec and checkov.

alexa: action items (putting rough dates inline):
- mohit: initial module skeleton + example app by Thu (2100008000)
- jess: README + cloud examples + compatibility matrix by Fri (2100009000)
- ben-platform: CI scaffold + smoke tests by Wed (2100010800)

mohit: ack. I'll also create a tiny demo app and a publishable sample repo that partners can fork.

alexa: blockers?

ben-platform: we need legal confirmation on marketplace asset signing + listing metadata requirements. Partnerships, can you help triage?

partners-team: noted — we'll coordinate with legal and product ops, should have guidance early next week.

jess: one more ask: include an optional step for marketplace telemetry hooks (ping to telemetry endpoint) in the examples so partners see how to integrate usage signals.

alexa: perfect. I'll open a follow-up thread focused on the announcement & co-marketing plan once we have the alpha preview. Thanks everyone.
